relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.name: Relic Mastodon Super-heavy Siege Transport
relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.transport:
This unit can transport friendly BLOOD ANGELS models in one of the following combinations:
- Up to 40 INFANTRY models.
- Up to 30 INFANTRY models and 1 DREADNOUGHT model.
- Up to 20 INFANTRY models and up to 2 DREADNOUGHT models. 
TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

storm-eagle-assault-gunship.name: Storm Eagle Assault Gunship
storm-eagle-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

caestus-assault-ram.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, CENTURION or TERMINATOR models.

thunderhawk-assault-gunship.name: Thunderhawk Assault Gunship
thunderhawk-assault-gunship.transport:
This unit can transport friendly BLOOD ANGELS models in one of the following combinations:
- Up to 30 INFANTRY (excluding PRIMARIS) or BIKER models.
- Up to 15 PRIMARIS INFANTRY models.
Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models.

thunderhawk-transporter.name: Thunderhawk Transporter
thunderhawk-transporter.transport:
This unit can transport up to 15 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY or BIKER models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

In addition, this unit can also transport one of the following:
- 1 LAND RAIDER model or RELIC SPARTAN ASSAULT TANK model.
- Up to 2 of the following models: RHINO, RAZORBACK, PREDATOR, WHIRLWIND, HUNTER, STALKER, VINDICATOR. 

LAND RAIDER, RELIC SPARTAN ASSAULT TANK, RHINO and RAZORBACK models can transport models whilst they are embarked aboard this unit.

sokar-pattern-stormbird.name: Sokar Pattern Stormbird
sokar-pattern-stormbird.transport: This unit can transport up to 50 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY or BIKER models, or up to 25 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY or BIKER models amd 1 RHINO model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION and BIKER model takes up the space of 3 other models. A RHINO can transport models whilst it is embarked aboard this unit.

damocles-command-rhino.name: Damocles Command Rhino
damocles-command-rhino.transport: This unit can transport 1 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY CHARACTER model. It cannot transport PRIMARIS, CENTURION or TERMINATOR model

lucius-pattern-dreadnought-drop-pod.name: Lucius Pattern Dreadnought Drop Pod
lucius-pattern-dreadnought-drop-pod.transport: This unit can transport 1 friendly BLOOD ANGELS DREADNOUGHT model.

castellum-stronghold-tacticus-bunker.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models.

castellum-stronghold-bunker-annex.name: Castellum Stronghold - Bunker Annex
castellum-stronghold-bunker-annex.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models.

impulsor.name: Impulsor
impulsor.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly BLOOD ANGELS PRIMARIS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK or MK X GRAVIS units.

chapter-master.name: Chapter Master
chapter-master.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

chapter-master-2.name: Chapter Master
chapter-master-2.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly FLESH TEARERS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

whirlwind-of-gore.name: Whirlwind of Gore
whirlwind-of-gore.text: At the end of the Action phase, you can place one blast marker next to one enemy LIGHT unit within 1" of this unit.

aura-of-fervour.name: Aura of Fervour
aura-of-fervour.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of all friendly BLOOD ANGELS LIGHT and BLOOD ANGELS DREADNOUGHT units whilst they are making Fight actions within 6" of this unit.

the-red-grail.name: The Red Grail
the-red-grail.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly LIGHT BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly SANGUINARY PRIEST units. In addition, you can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly LIGHT BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

blood-chalice.name: Blood Chalice
blood-chalice.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly LIGHT BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly SANGUINARY PRIEST units.

lord-of-death.name: Lord of Death
lord-of-death.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove one blast marker from this unit.

mass-of-doom.name: Mass of Doom
mass-of-doom.text: Once per battle, before this unit makes a Move action, you can declare that it will chant the Mass of Doom. If this unit chants the Mass of Doom, then until the end of the turn, friendly BLOOD ANGELS units gain the Ignore Damage (5+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

redeemer-of-the-lost.name: Redeemer of the Lost
redeemer-of-the-lost.text: Friendly BLOOD ANGELS units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit. In addition, Morale tests taken for friendly DEATH COMPANY units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

guardian-of-the-lost.name: Guardian of the Lost
guardian-of-the-lost.text: Friendly DEATH COMPANY units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

fury-unbound.name: Fury Unbound
fury-unbound.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly DEATH COMPANY units whilst they are within 6" of this model.

blood-angels-chapter-banner.name: Blood Angels Chapter Banner
blood-angels-chapter-banner.text: Friendly BLOOD ANGELS units automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 9" of this model.

archangel-standard.name: Archangel Standard
archangel-standard.text: Morale tests taken for friendly BLOOD ANGELS units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit. In addition, you can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

blessing-of-the-omnissiah.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
blessing-of-the-omnissiah.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly BLOOD ANGELS VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

data-augurs.name: Data Augurs
data-augurs.text: Change this unit’s Ballistic Skill characteristic to 2+ whilst it is within 6" of any friendly BLOOD ANGELS RHINO PRIMARIS units.

servo-skull-hub.name: Servo-skull Hub
servo-skull-hub.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove one small blast marker from one friendly BLOOD ANGELS VEHICLE unit within 6" of this unit.

mindlock.name: Mindlock
mindlock.text: Change this unit’s Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics to 4+ whilst it is within 6" of at least one friendly BLOOD ANGELS TECHMARINE.

command-squad-bodyguard.name: Command Squad Bodyguard
command-squad-bodyguard.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly BLOOD ANGELS LIGHT CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.

narthecium.name: Narthecium
narthecium.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly BLOOD ANGELS LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

litanies-of-hate.name: Litanies of Hate
litanies-of-hate.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

spiritual-leader.name: Spiritual Leader
spiritual-leader.text: Friendly BLOOD ANGELS units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

abhor-the-beast.name: Abhor the Beast
abhor-the-beast.text: Add D3 to this model’s Attacks characteristic whilst it is making a Fight action within 1" of any enemy ORKS units.

rites-of-battle.name: Rites of Battle
rites-of-battle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

tactical-precision.name: Tactical Precision
tactical-precision.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

heirs-of-azkaellon.name: Heirs of Azkaellon
heirs-of-azkaellon.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit whilst it is within 6" of any friendly BLOOD ANGELS WARLORD units.

astartes-banner.name: Astartes Banner
astartes-banner.text: Morale tests taken for friendly BLOOD ANGELS units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

castellum-stronghold.name: Castellum Stronghold
castellum-stronghold.text: This unit can only be included in a Fortification Network Detachment that only includes 1 BLOOD ANGELS Tacticus Bunker unit and 3 BLOOD ANGELS Bunker Annex units. All 3 Bunker Annex units occupy a single Fortification slot, and the Tacticus Bunker begins the battle as the Commander of its Detachment.
